description: Express.js route handlers for instructor-related endpoints in an LMS backend, including dashboard stats, course enrollments, submission stats, quiz attempts, and assessments.

methods.name: GET /instructor/dashboard-stats
methods.description: Provides KPIs for instructor dashboard such as active courses, enrolled learners, pending reviews, and learners at risk.

methods.name: GET /instructor/courses/:courseId/enrollments
methods.description: Lists learners enrolled in a specific course, verifying instructor ownership.

methods.name: GET /instructor/courses/:courseId/submission-stats
methods.description: Returns quiz and assessment submission counts for a course.

methods.name: GET /instructor/courses/:courseId/quiz-attempts
methods.description: Lists recent quiz attempts for a course.

methods.name: GET /instructor/submissions
methods.description: Lists all quiz and assignment submissions across instructor’s courses.

methods.name: GET /instructor/my-courses
methods.description: Lists instructor’s created courses with enrollment counts.

methods.name: GET /instructor/assessments
methods.description: Lists assessments created by instructor, including submission counts.
